#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# healthcheck.sh - Check the health of services running on ports 3000 and 8080
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 - All services are healthy
#   1 - One or more services are down
#   2 - Missing required dependencies

set -uo pipefail

# Configuration
HOST="${HEALTHCHECK_HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT:-5}"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
SERVICE_NAMES=("Frontend (3000)" "Backend (8080)")

# Color output (only if stdout is a TTY)
if [ -t 1 ]; then
    RED='\033[0;31m'
    GREEN='\033[0;32m'
    YELLOW='\033[0;33m'
    BOLD='\033[1m'
    RESET='\033[0m'
else
    RED='' GREEN='' YELLOW='' BOLD='' RESET=''
fi

# Check a single TCP port. Returns 0 if open, 1 if closed.
check_port() {
    local host="$1"
    local port="$2"
    local timeout="$3"

    if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        nc -z -w "$timeout" "$host" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
        return $?
    elif command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        curl -sf --max-time "$timeout" "http://${host}:${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1
        # curl returns non-zero on HTTP errors too; treat connection as success
        # by checking if we can connect at all (exit code 7 = connection failed)
        local rc=$?
        if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 22 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 52 ]; then
            return 0
        fi
        return 1
    else
        # Fallback: use bash's /dev/tcp
        timeout "$timeout" bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/${host}/${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1
        return $?
    fi
}

# Try an HTTP request to gather more detail (status code). Best-effort.
http_status() {
    local host="$1"
    local port="$2"
    local timeout="$3"

    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time "$timeout" \
            "http://${host}:${port}" 2>/dev/null || echo "---"
    else
        echo "n/a"
    fi
}

main() {
    echo -e "${BOLD}Health Check Report${RESET}"
    echo    "==================="
    echo    "Host:    $HOST"
    echo    "Timeout: ${TIMEOUT}s"
    echo    "Time:    $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
    echo

    local failures=0
    local i=0
    for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
        local name="${SERVICE_NAMES[$i]}"
        printf "  %-20s " "$name"

        if check_port "$HOST" "$port" "$TIMEOUT"; then
            local status
            status="$(http_status "$HOST" "$port" "$TIMEOUT")"
            echo -e "[${GREEN}UP${RESET}]   HTTP ${status}"
        else
            echo -e "[${RED}DOWN${RESET}] connection refused / timed out"
            failures=$((failures + 1))
        fi
        i=$((i + 1))
    done

    echo
    if [ "$failures" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}All services are healthy.${RESET}"
        exit 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}${failures} service(s) are down.${RESET}"
        exit 1
    fi
}
